priority.override_reason: Ranks 1 through 15 are closed for this cycle by the current exact direct-frame, object-storage, RegExp, string, constructor, typed-loop, and rejected branchy-AES evidence. The fresh rank-16 bitops-bits-in-byte profile now places 1,496 of 4,042 top-of-stack samples inside the already-retained typed-loop operation executor, while its entry, scratch, and register-file lifecycle costs are small and the prior compact register-file units are consumed. Rank-17 MD5 places only 440 of 3,129 samples in the already-retained Number-only program and exposes no new admission boundary. Rank-18 instead has a bounded compiler gap: 1,843 of 3,940 useful samples are in the general numeric-leaf evaluator plus direct_number_binary because pure local compound assignment emits statically numeric Dup, Pop, and ToNumeric operations that the existing Number-only compiler rejects. Extending that immutable-bytecode admission is lower-cost and has a materially larger removable fraction than another typed-loop dispatch or retained MD5-layout retry.

mechanism.summary: Extend the existing Number-only direct-leaf compiler and scalar executor to admit stack manipulation and local mutation operations whose abstract stack values are already proven ECMAScript Numbers. Numeric Dup, Pop, ToNumeric, and Update shapes remain in the scalar program, allowing ordinary local compound assignments to avoid FastValue tags, direct_number_binary, and upvalue-commit bookkeeping on every call.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility depends only on immutable direct-leaf bytecode, the existing numeric abstract dataflow, authoritative parameter and local slots, and live Number arguments. The program may duplicate or discard only an abstract Number, treats ToNumeric as an identity only after that proof, and updates only mutable local scalar state. A received upvalue, missing or non-Number argument, coercive value, observable property or call operation, control flow, unsupported stack type, or any other unsupported bytecode declines before user-visible work to the unchanged general direct-leaf or full-VM route. The mechanism never inspects source paths, benchmark or function names, input values beyond Number type, iteration counts, checksums, or expected results.
semantic_risks: preserving the exact duplicated assignment value and expression-statement discard order for local compound assignments while omitting only statically dead undefined completion values
keeping ToNumeric an identity only for an abstract Number so Symbol, BigInt, object coercion, and abrupt completion remain on the existing observable path
implementing prefix and postfix numeric Update stack results correctly if admitted, including NaN, infinity, signed zero, and decrement behavior
never treating a received upvalue store as a local scalar store or bypassing the existing delayed shared-cell commit protocol
retaining the dedicated NumericLeafPlan variant layout and unchanged execution path for previously admitted Number-only programs such as safe_add
falling back before observable work whenever parameter arity, live argument types, local mutability, stack depth, or bytecode shape differs from the compiled proof

This confirms that the scalar executor is a live shared mechanism and makes MD5 a mandatory no-regression control: the new admission may add only payload-neutral operation variants and must not move or enlarge the surrounding general plan layout.
